environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind a Network Load Balancer (Layer 4 only, no payload inspection). The application is exposed on port 3000 with no request body validation middleware. The INTERNAL_SECRET is set via environment variable. API keys are distributed to consuming services via the /admin/key endpoint. No request size limits or schema validation is applied at any layer.

config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3000
